hooks.text: 击败恶魔后夺走其招牌能力，直接装进自己的卡组
hooks.excerpt: Better yet, you get to keep and use your opponents' signature abilities in your own deck!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用Mod卡反复编辑武器卡，边打边重组手牌与状态效果
hooks.excerpt: Equip Mod Cards to enhance and modify your Weapon Cards — edit, experiment, adapt, and reformulate your hand and card combinations as you go and refine your personal playstyle!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 《神曲》结局之后，但丁失忆重返地狱，再次攀向天堂寻找答案
hooks.excerpt: Hell Maiden picks up from the ending of the original Divine Comedy by Dante Alighieri. Dante is now inexplicably back in Hell after having reached Paradiso — and she's lost all her memories to boot!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 高饱和武器特效铺满画面且缺少透明度调节，造成视觉不适。
